sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Tôi cần một bản in của tài liệu này. works best as one short line, with the receipt, room number, ride detail, photo, or last location doing the extra explaining. Say Tôi cần một bản in của tài liệu này.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Good next-step cards: I’m lost, I left something behind, and I need help.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: At a desk or counter, or during a help moment, keep the receipt, room number, ride detail, photo, or last location visible while the first answer comes back.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Name one problem at a time. If the answer is fast, switch to a repeat or write-it-down phrase.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These follow-ups cover location, receipt, contact, or handoff detail: I need help, Please call the hotel for me, and I need the manager.
